# Paintings by Mery (paintingsuae.com)

> Official website of Mery Zakkak, a painter, creative mentor and art workshop facilitator based in Abu Dhabi, UAE. She sells original paintings (acrylic, fluid art and mixed media on canvas, wood and paper), takes commissions, offers studio visits in Abu Dhabi, and runs art workshops for kids (ages 6+) and adults, including a creative art expression course and seasonal vision board workshops (in person in Abu Dhabi and live online).

## Key facts
- Artist: Mery Zakkak. Moved from Lebanon to the UAE in 2018; painting became her way of coping with change, which led to her memoir "Art as My Therapy" (2026).
- Training: Training Diploma in Art Therapy (2025), Albyan Institute Education Support Services, Abu Dhabi (licensed by ACTVET).
- Languages: English, Arabic and French.
- Location: studio in the Zayed Sports City area, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Studio visits by appointment.
- Portfolio: 66 works across 12 series; 45 currently available, priced from AED 50 to AED 4,500 at full price.
- Sale: selected paintings from 2024 and earlier are 40% off until 14 February 2027 (prices below are the current prices).
- Every painting is a one-of-a-kind original; prints are not available at the moment.
- Buying: payment by bank transfer; collection in Abu Dhabi, UAE delivery or international shipping (paid by the buyer, quoted before payment); all sales final.
- Kids' art workshops: ages 6+, around AED 250 per child depending on the workshop and group, arranged around the group's needs. One-on-one classes from AED 250.
- Creative art expression course: painting as a reflective, therapeutic practice, no experience needed; one session, one month or the full 90-day (12-week) journey.
- Group and corporate workshops: across the UAE or online.
- Contact: WhatsApp +971 56 338 0577, email merycreativejourney@gmail.com.
- Profiles: Instagram @paintings.bymery and @merycreativejourney, YouTube @MeryCreativeJourney (https://www.youtube.com/@MeryCreativeJourney), Pinterest MeryCreativeJourney (https://www.pinterest.com/MeryCreativeJourney/).
- Press: UAE Stories, "Mery Zakkak transforming creativity" (https://uaestories.com/mery-zakkak-transforming-creativity/).

## Journal
- [How to buy an original painting in Abu Dhabi](https://paintingsuae.com/journal/buy-original-painting-abu-dhabi/) (2026-11-20): A painter's practical guide to buying original art in Abu Dhabi: choosing the size, light and colours, budget, seeing it in person, delivery and care.
- [Art as therapy in Abu Dhabi: what a creative art session is like](https://paintingsuae.com/journal/art-as-therapy-abu-dhabi/) (2026-11-20): No art skills needed. Painter Mery Zakkak explains what happens in her creative art expression sessions in Abu Dhabi and online, and who they are for.
- [Arabic page / بالعربية](https://paintingsuae.com/ar/): introduction and the questions above in Arabic (name in Arabic: ماري زكاك).

## Questions
- **Where can I buy original paintings in Abu Dhabi?** Mery Zakkak sells original acrylic, fluid art and mixed media paintings from her Abu Dhabi studio. You can see every available painting with its size and price at paintingsuae.com/gallery, and arrange a studio visit by WhatsApp (+971 56 338 0577) or email.
- **How much do the paintings cost?** Original paintings range from AED 50 for small pieces to AED 4,500 for large statement works, and every price is listed in the gallery. Selected paintings from 2024 and earlier are 40% off until 14 February 2027.
- **Are the paintings originals or prints?** Every painting on the site is a one-of-a-kind original, painted by hand by Mery Zakkak. They are not prints or copies, and prints are not available at the moment.
- **Does Mery Zakkak take commissions?** Yes. Mery accepts commissioned paintings. Contact her by WhatsApp or email with the size, colours and story you have in mind; the price depends on the project.
- **Do you deliver paintings in the UAE or abroad?** Yes. You can collect your painting in Abu Dhabi, or ask for delivery within the UAE or international shipping. The buyer pays delivery or shipping, and you get a quote before you pay.
- **How do I pay for a painting?** Paintings are paid for by bank transfer. The bank details are shared when you confirm your purchase.
- **Can I visit the studio?** Yes. Mery's studio is in the Zayed Sports City area of Abu Dhabi, and you can see a painting in person there before you buy. Message Mery on WhatsApp to arrange a studio visit.
- **Are there art workshops for kids in Abu Dhabi?** Yes. Mery runs kids' art workshops in Abu Dhabi for children aged 6 and up, where they explore colour, texture and play. A workshop costs around AED 250 per child, depending on the workshop and the group, and sessions can be arranged around your group's needs. Message her on WhatsApp or by email to ask about the next dates.
- **Is there an art course for adults who are not artists?** Yes. Mery's creative art expression course uses painting as a reflective, therapeutic practice, and no artistic experience is needed. You can join for a single session, one month, or the full 90-day (12-week) journey, starting when you are ready.
- **Does Mery have training in art therapy?** Yes. Mery holds a Training Diploma in Art Therapy (2025) from Albyan Institute Education Support Services in Abu Dhabi, a training centre licensed by ACTVET, the Abu Dhabi Centre for Technical and Vocational Education and Training.
- **Do you run private, group or corporate art workshops?** Yes. Mery offers private one-on-one classes, from AED 250 depending on what you work on, and tailored workshops for teams, friends and celebrations, across the UAE or online.
- **Can I join a workshop online?** Yes. Some workshops, such as the New Year, New You vision board workshop, can be joined live online.
- **What is "Art as My Therapy"?** Art as My Therapy is Mery Zakkak's memoir about leaving Lebanon in 2018 and how painting helped her through it. The complete book is available on Amazon in paperback and on Kindle, and you can read the first three chapters free as a PDF on paintingsuae.com.
- **Can I share photos of your paintings?** Yes, you can share a link or repost for personal, non-commercial use with clear credit to @paintings.bymery. For printing, products, publications or advertising, ask first at merycreativejourney@gmail.com.

## Available paintings
- Lost in the City (Find Your Wave, 2023): Acrylic on canvas, 70 × 50 cm, 4 cm deep. AED 2,700 (40% off, was AED 4,500). A woman with dark curls sits with her back to us, looking past a deep blue sea towards a dreamlike city skyline. White waves curl through the sky and burst into textured flowers, as if her thoughts were rising off the canvas. It's about feeling small in a big new city and still finding beauty in it. At 70 × 50 cm, it is one of the series' statement pieces. Perfect for: A living room or entrance wall that needs a strong focal point; anyone who has moved to a new city. Page: https://paintingsuae.com/paintings/lost-in-the-city/
- Maybe I Didn’t Want to Move On (Angels Still Between Worlds, 2025): Mixed media on canvas, 70 × 50 cm, 4.5 cm deep, Silver wood frame. AED 3,700. A falling angel surrounded by deep blues and blacks, the heavy weight of past memories. Yet a bright beam of light breaks through the darkness below: hope, and the chance for new beginnings. Falling can lead to rising again if we choose to embrace the light. Perfect for: Above a sofa or bed where its depth can be seen up close; collectors of expressive mixed media work. It comes in a silver wood frame, ready to hang. Page: https://paintingsuae.com/paintings/maybe-i-didn-t-want-to-move-on/
